waypoints.advice: Mina Clavero closes the day.

sections.advice: Cordoba → Copina is 66 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.
Copina → Pampa de Achala climbs about 2200 m in 19 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Pampa de Achala → Mina Clavero drops about 2200 m over 21 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.

scenicChapters.title: Camino de las Altas Cumbres
scenicChapters.narrative: Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it. The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2200 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

camino-de-las-altas-cumbres.story: A one-way ride of 195 km, Córdoba to Mina Clavero - roughly 2 h 37 in the saddle. On the way it passes Copina and Pampa de Achala. The highest point is about 2,200 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
